grammar.title: 需改变时态的间接陈述句（时态后移）
grammar.structure: 主句（过去时 said/told）+ (that) + 从句（时态往回移一步）
grammar.definition: 转述通常发生在过去，引述动词是过去时，因此从句时态通常要「往回移」（back shift）：一般现在→一般过去，现在进行→过去进行，现在完成→过去完成，一般将来→过去将来（would）。
grammar.usage: She said (that) she was thirsty. / She told me (that) she had just made a new film.

examples.en: 'I'm having a rest,' she told them. → She told them (that) she was having a rest.
examples.zh: 她告诉他们说她当时正在休息。

examples.en: 'I'll have to ask my husband,' she said. → She said (that) she would have to ask her husband.
examples.zh: 她说她将得去问问她丈夫。

grammar.title: say 与 tell 的区别
grammar.definition: say 的宾语是「说的话」，不直接跟人（跟人要说 said to me）；tell 后面必须先跟「人」：told me / told reporters / told us。
grammar.usage: He said he was busy. = He told me (that) he was busy.

examples.en: She said (that) she was going to retire.
examples.zh: 她说她准备退休。

examples.en: She told reporters she felt very tired.
examples.zh: 她告诉记者她感到很疲劳。

grammar.title: 间接引语中情态动词的转化
grammar.definition: 转述时情态动词由现在式改成过去式；已经是过去式的情态助动词（could, would, might, must）在转述时不再变化。
grammar.usage: 'I can see you tomorrow.' → She said she could see me the next day.

examples.en: 'I'll help you,' she said. → She said she would help me.
examples.zh: 她说她会帮助我。

examples.en: 'I may return at six o'clock,' she told me. → She told me she might return at six o'clock.
examples.zh: 她告诉我她可能6点钟回来。

lines.speaker: KATE
lines.en: Let's buy a newspaper, Liz. Listen to this! "Karen Marsh: Sensational News! By our reporter, Alan Jones. Miss Karen Marsh arrived at London Airport today. She was wearing a blue dress and a mink coat. She told me she had just made a new film. She said she was not going to make another. She said she was going to retire. She told reporters she felt very tired and didn't want to make another film for a long time."
lines.zh: 我们买份报纸吧，莉兹。你听这段：“卡伦·马什：爆炸性新闻！由本报记者艾伦·琼斯报导。卡伦·马什今天到达伦敦机场。她穿着一身蓝色的套装和一件貂皮大衣。她告诉我她刚拍完一部新片子。她不准备再拍电影了。她说她准备退休。她告诉记者她感到很疲劳，早就不想再拍电影了。”
lines.note: 报道里全是间接引语：had just made / was going to retire

questions.q: Why do tenses 'move back' in reported speech?
questions.zh: 转述别人原话时，为什么从句的时态要「往回移」？
questions.a: Because the original words were spoken some time before they are reported, and the reporting verb (said/told) is in the past — so the reported clause shifts back one step (present → past, present perfect → past perfect).
questions.aZh: 因为原话是在转述之前说的，而引述动词 said/told 是过去时，所以从句时态要整体后退一步：现在时→过去时，现在完成时→过去完成时。
questions.hint: 想想「说话的时间点」和「转述的时间点」谁先谁后。

questions.a: She told me the book was interesting.

questions.hint: tell 后跟人；am/is → was，have done → had done。

title: Sensational news / He said he was busy ...
subtitle: 轰动新闻 / 他说他很忙……

lead.question: 朋友告诉你「我刚拍完一部新电影」，你转述给别人时说「她说她刚拍完一部新电影」——英文里时态要怎么「往回拨」？
lead.warmup: 先别看课文。把别人的原话转述给第三者叫间接引语：She said (that) she was thirsty. 原话 I'm thirsty 里的 am 变成了 was。规律是「时态后移」：一般现在→一般过去，现在进行→过去进行，现在完成→过去完成，will→would，can→could，may→might。还要分清 say 和 tell：tell 后面必须跟人（told me / told reporters），say 不跟人。先试着把 'I'm tired.' 转述成 She said she was tired.，再听记者怎么把女明星的话写进报纸。
goals: 掌握直接引语变间接引语的时态后移规则（现在→过去，现在完成→过去完成）
分清 say (said) 与 tell (told sb) 的用法
掌握 retire / reporter / mink coat 等新闻常用词
会用 She said (that) ... / She told me (that) ... 转述别人的话
lead.summary: 第 133 课记者在机场采访影星 Karen Marsh：刚拍完新片吗？还拍吗？——不拍了，她要退休，觉得很累。随后 Kate 和 Liz 买报纸，读到记者 Alan Jones 的报道：报道里女明星的话全变成了间接引语——she had just made a new film, she was going to retire... 第 134 课操练把 'I'm busy.' 变成 He said he was busy.，并练习 said / told 与过去完成时。
lead.tips: ① 转述通常发生在过去，所以引述动词用过去时 said/told，从句时态随之「往回移」；② said 不直接跟人，跟人要说 said to me；tell 后必须跟人：told me / told reporters；③ 现在完成 'I've just made a film' → she had just made a film；④ going to → was going to；will → would；can → could；may → might；⑤ make another = make another film，another 后省略了名词；⑥ Well, fancy that! 哎呀，真想不到！（表惊讶）。
